1. **Blocking: `jit issue status --json` does not emit JSON errors for id failures.** In [main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:1964), the status command maps ids through `build_issue_show_response(...).collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?`; any missing, ambiguous, or invalid id escapes directly to `main`. `main` only emits JSON for startup repository errors ([main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:1393)), while adjacent `issue show` uses `handle_json_error!` for issue lookup failures ([main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:1951)). This means `jit issue status deadbeef --json` can fail with human stderr and no machine-readable JSON payload, violating the CLI contract that every command supports `--json`. The new tests only cover non-JSON unknown-id failure ([issue_status_projection_tests.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/tests/issue_status_projection_tests.rs:320)), so this regression is unpinned.
